scope.behavior: Non-final authenticated replication suffixes select the largest contiguous block range fitting a 64 MiB payload target. The existing 256 MiB decompressed fetch/apply ceiling remains enforced; HMAC authentication, base/end continuity, per-batch integrity, and final-state seal validation are unchanged. The dedicated recovery tool handles only the existing ynx-chaind binary and a candidate release manifest; it preserves services, units, environment and chain state.

firstLiveAttempt.detail: The service required more than the original two-second readiness window. It was restored to its prior binary and active state; candidate binary did not remain active. The revised tool waits up to forty seconds and removes a newly written candidate manifest on rollback.
